performance.metric: Reliability — MPFM calibration verification / proof-test interval
performance.basis: Emerson Roxar 2600 FAQ: 'with a typical recommendation being yearly checks and verification. Calibration is typically verified using test separator data or sampling' — no failure rate printed
Emerson: 'The meter has no moving parts, reducing wear and maintenance needs, and a robust design, reducing failures and the need for spare parts'

performance.metric: Export — rigid flowline and export pipeline diameter range (TechnipFMC)
performance.basis: TechnipFMC rigid pipelines: 'range from small diameter 4-inch pipes for oilfield service fluids, to 18-inch infield lines, to larger diameter export trunk lines connecting offshore processing facilities to onshore receiving facilities'

performance.metric: Export — flexible riser diameter, West Desaru WSS pig launcher
performance.basis: West Desaru WSS houses a pig launcher and an 8-in (20-cm) flexible riser

performance.metric: Flare — knock-out drum size range (FlareTech fabricator range)
performance.basis: FlareTech Inc. Flare Knockout Drums page: 'designed and manufactured Flare Knockout Drums from small 2 Barrels (BBL) to large 600BBL volumes'

performance.metric: Design basis — minimum margin between high trip pressure and PSV set pressure (NORSOK P-001 Table 1)
performance.basis: NORSOK P-001 Ed 5 sec. 4.2.1 Table 1: for a high trip pressure of 0-35 barg the minimum margin is 3.5 bar; above 35 barg it is 10% of PSV set pressure; for systems without a high-pressure trip the margin applies between maximum operating pressure and PSV set pressure

performance.metric: Design basis — flare and vent line sizing limits (NORSOK P-001 sec. 6.5)
performance.basis: NORSOK P-001 Ed 5 sec. 6.5: all flare lines designed to keep rho-V below 200,000 kg/ms; flare headers and sub-headers for a maximum velocity of Mach 0.6

performance.metric: Design basis — drain header sizes and gravity slopes (NORSOK P-001 sec. 6)
performance.basis: NORSOK P-001 Ed 5: minimum sewage and open-drain header DN 100 (4 in) with sub-headers DN 80 (3 in); gravity lines minimum downward slope 1:100, and at least 1:50 where mud and/or sand is present; the liquid inlet to a dump caisson should be tangential and sloped downwards

performance.metric: Export — condensate and gas export line sizes at a minimum facility platform (PTTEP Arthit MFP)
performance.basis: JPT: an 8-in condensate line to a floating storage unit and a 42-in gas export line serve the field; the MFP ties back to the existing wellhead platform by subsea pipeline

advantages: Minimum-facility WHPs avoid onboard processing by exporting fluids to a host
limitations: Many component figures are not published on freely readable pages; gaps are recorded

notes: API Spec 6A Wellhead and Christmas tree equipment (listed on the Christmas tree page) — Production manifold / headers with produ | API Spec 17D Subsea wellhead and tree equipment (listed on the Christmas tree page) — Production manifold / headers with produ | ISO 10423:2009 Petroleum and natural gas industries — Drilling and production equipment — Wellhead and Christmas tree equipment — Production manifold / headers with produ | API RP 14C, 8th ed (2017) Analysis, Design, Installation, and Testing of Safety Systems for Offshore Production Facilities — safety flow chart and scope figures — Production manifold / headers with pr | API Spec 6A Wellhead and Christmas tree equipment — examples of manual and actuated tree valve configurations — Chokes and choke manifolds | API Spec 17D Subsea wellhead and tree equipment — Chokes and choke manifolds | ISO 10423:2009 Petroleum and natural gas industries — Wellhead and Christmas tree equipment — Chokes and choke manifolds | Patent US20120273228A Process chain as recorded in the sources: well fluid leaves each christmas tree, is gathered in the production manifold (with a separate test header to the test separator or multiphase meter), passes the choke and chemical-injection points, and leaves via the pig launcher and export riser/pipeline to the host; Devold sec. 2.3 is the readable end-to-end description and JPT shows the same chain realised on a minimum facility platform.
